achievements.name: Cradle
achievements.description: Claim a Base or Buy a Freighter

steps: Follow the opening tutorial missions until you learn how to place a Base Computer.
Claim a site to build your first base, or purchase a Freighter after a space battle.

achievements.name: Foundation
achievements.description: Attain 'Entrepreneur' status in Most Units Accrued

steps: Mine valuable minerals like Copper or Gold and sell them at space station trade terminals.
Accumulate a total balance of 150,000 Units.
Interact with Knowledge Stones on planet surfaces or talk to alien NPCs in space stations.
Learn a total of 10 words from any alien dialect (Gek, Korvax, Vy'keen).

achievements.name: Contact
achievements.description: Attain 'Known' status in Alien Colonist Encounters

steps: Visit a space station or planetary trade post.
Talk to 2 individual alien NPCs.
Encounter pirate starships during space travel or respond to distress calls.
Destroy 1 hostile starship in space combat.

achievements.name: The Space Merchants
achievements.description: Attain 'Trader' status in Most Units Accrued

steps: Install S-class Scanner upgrades on your Multi-Tool to earn large Unit payouts per fauna scan.
Accumulate a total balance of 1,000,000 Units.
Explore planet surfaces on foot without entering ships or exocraft.
Traverse a distance of 50,000 u on foot.

achievements.name: The Diamond Age
achievements.description: Attain 'Magnate' status in Most Units Accrued

steps: Set up mineral extractors or harvest Storm Crystals during hazardous weather.
Accumulate a peak balance of 2,000,000 Units.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Buying 3 S-class Scanner Upgrades makes this achievable in under 30 minutes by scanning animals.

steps: Craft hyperdrive warp cells using Antimatter and Antimatter Housing.
Warp to your second unique star system.
Explore alien monoliths, ruins, and Knowledge Stones across multiple planets.
Learn a total of 50 words from alien dialects.
Traverse planet surfaces using sprint and Melee-Jetpack jump boosts.
Accumulate a total on-foot distance of 75,000 u.
Construct an Exocraft Geobay (e.g. Roamer, Nomad, or Minotaur) at your base using the build menu.

achievements.name: Who Goes There?
achievements.description: Attain 'Diplomat' status in Alien Colonist Encounters

steps: Visit planetary outposts and space stations.
Interact directly with 20 distinct alien NPCs.
Upgrade your starship shields and weapons (e.g., Infra-Knife Accelerator).
Destroy 5 hostile pirate starships.

achievements.name: What Mad Universe
achievements.description: Attain 'Ambassador' status in Alien Colonist Encounters

steps: Systematically speak to all NPCs at space stations and trade platforms.
Reach a total of 40 individual alien encounters.
Accept bounty hunting contracts at space station Mission Boards or fight Sentinel waves.
Destroy a cumulative total of 80 enemy starships.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: High-conflict systems trigger frequent pirate raids on freighters for rapid targets.

steps: Maintain a steady supply of hyperdrive fuel.
Perform hyperdrive warps to visit a total of 20 unique star systems.
Summon the Space Anomaly in any star system.
Head to the Giant Teleporter inside the Space Anomaly and select any featured player base to warp directly to it.
Talk to NPCs in space stations and request language assistance repeatedly.
Learn a cumulative total of 150 words across alien dialects.

achievements.name: A Scanner Darkly
achievements.description: Attain 'Naturalist' status in Planet Zoology Scanned

steps: Land on a planet with a small fauna count (e.g., 1 to 5 animal species listed in the Discovery tab).
Scan every species on the planet, then press 'Complete Collection' to upload.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Exotic / Anomaly worlds (Glitch planets) only have 1 animal species, making completion instant.

steps: Traverse planet surfaces across your playthrough.
Walk a cumulative total distance of 100,000 u on foot.

achievements.name: The Star Beast
achievements.description: Attain 'Archivist' status in Planet Zoology Scanned

steps: Locate 5 distinct planets and discover 100% of the fauna on each.
Remember to claim the complete collection reward from the Discovery menu for each planet.

achievements.name: Galapagos
achievements.description: Attain 'Encyclopedia' status in Planet Zoology Scanned

steps: Search for Synthetic / Mechanical worlds in uninhabited systems (they usually have only 2 robot species).
Achieve 100% fauna discovery on 10 unique planets.
Land on an Extreme hazard world or Aggressive Sentinel planet.
Survive on the planet surface for 14 SOLS (approx. 5.5 hours real time).
warnings: Dying on an extreme planet resets your continuous SOL timer to zero.

steps: Find an Extreme weather world or Aggressive Sentinel planet.
Remain alive on the planet surface for a cumulative total of 32 SOLS (approx. 12.8 hours real time).
communityNotes: Reddit tip: You can build a small enclosed metal room on an extreme world and safely stand inside while AFK — the timer will continue ticking.
warnings: Do not sit inside your starship or deep cave systems, as safety zones stop the timer.

achievements.name: Take a Deep Breath
achievements.description: Reach the Centre of the Galaxy in Survival Mode

steps: Start a new save game on Survival Mode difficulty.
Locate a planetary Portal and dial the first glyph ('Sunset') 12 times to teleport ~3,000 ly from the core.
Fully charge your hyperdrive and make the final jump into the Galactic Centre.
warnings: Survival mode features smaller inventory stack sizes and higher environmental damage.

achievements.name: To Live Forever
achievements.description: Reach the Centre of the Galaxy in Permadeath Mode

steps: Start a new save file in Permadeath mode.
Play cautiously through early hazards until you unlock basic warp capability and Portal glyphs.
Use a Portal with the '12x Sunset Glyph' code to warp near the core (~3,000 ly away) and execute the final jump.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Unlocking 'To Live Forever' automatically triggers 'Take a Deep Breath' at the same time!
warnings: Dying in Permadeath mode permanently erases your save file. Always keep hazard recharges handy.
